name: ShadowLess Light
source:
You receive a job offer to work as a detective for the ShadowLess Light Corporation. You'll be solving crimes for your clients, backed by all the power and influence of one of the world's largest corporations.

For your first case, an AI is implanted into your mind, and you're sent to recover a mysterious stolen item that the client refuses to identify. Will you solve the case on your own, or will you need help? 

There are no game overs—only plenty of choices and multiple paths leading to different endings.
translation:
你收到了一份来自“无影之光集团”的录用通知，受聘担任企业侦探。背靠全球最庞大的商业巨头之一的滔天权势与影响力，你将为客户侦破一桩桩棘手案件。

接手第一桩案件时，公司向你的大脑中植入了一套AI系统，派你前去追回一件委托人拒绝透露具体名目的神秘失窃物。你究竟会凭一己之力独立破案，还是需要寻求他人的协助？

本作没有任何游戏失败（Game Over）判定——唯有丰富的抉择与通往不同结局的多条分支路线。
